card_comparison: All eighteen top-level source problems are represented by source-local cards P-BKF88-1 through P-BKF88-18.
known_extractor_defects: Problem 8 renders Im z as a malformed blackboard-S glyph; the card restores the strip as -pi/2 < Im z < pi/2 from the deterministic complex-analytic context.
Problem 10 appends a stray subscript-like glyph to p in 'order 2p'; the card restores the explicitly quantified prime p.
Problem 6 and several prose lines contain spacing/OCR word-fragment noise that does not alter their mathematical content.
